source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,223 records)

talents.name: Improved Heroic Strike
ranks: Reduces the cost of your Heroic Strike ability by 1 Rage.

talents.name: Deflection
ranks: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Improved Rend
ranks: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Charge
ranks: Increases the Rage generated by your Charge ability by 3.

talents.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
ranks: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

talents.name: Improved Thunder Clap
ranks: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.

talents.name: Improved Overpower
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 25%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Overpower ability by 50%.

talents.name: Anger Management
ranks: Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

talents.name: Deep Wounds
ranks: Your critical strikes cause your opponent to Bleed, dealing 0% of your melee weapon's average damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes

ranks: Your attacks with Maces and Staves ignore 15% of your target's armor.

talents.name: Weaponmaster

talents.name: Improved Hamstring

talents.name: Mortal Strike
ranks: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Booming Voice
ranks: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces the Rage cost by of your Shouts and Howls by 25%.

talents.name: Cruelty
ranks: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Blood Craze
ranks: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

ranks: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Battle Shout by 5%.

ranks: Reduces the Rage cost of your Execute ability by 5.

talents.name: Enrage
ranks: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 0% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Slam ability by 5 sec, the cast time and global cooldown by 0.5 sec, and Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing.

talents.name: Death Wish
ranks: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Intercept ability by 10 sec.

ranks: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

talents.name: Flurry
ranks: Increases your melee attack speed by 1% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.name: Bloodthirst
ranks: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
ranks: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

talents.name: Anticipation
ranks: Increases your Defense Skill by 20.

talents.name: Improved Bloodrage
ranks: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

talents.name: Toughness

talents.name: Iron Will
ranks: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.

ranks: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.
